# Strava Trigger

## Summary

Learn how to use the Strava Trigger node in n8n.

Learn how to use the Strava Trigger node in n8n. Follow technical documentation to integrate Strava Trigger node into your workflows.

[Strava](https://www.strava.com/) is an internet service for tracking human exercise which incorporates social network features.

{% hint style="info" %}
**Credentials**

Refer to the [Strava credentials documentation](/integrations/builtin/credentials/strava) for authentication information for this node.
{% endhint %}

{% hint style="info" %}
**Examples and templates**

For usage examples and templates to help you get started, refer to n8n's [Strava Trigger integrations](https://n8n.io/integrations/strava-trigger/) page.
{% endhint %}
